subject: Shiny is seeing modules from another Project in a new Project

messages.author: 5c6455b85862fd52
messages.subject: Shiny is seeing modules from another Project in a new Project
parts:
Hi,

I just started coding up a new app in a separate project tab and I left a couple ui names from a prior project and they are populating in the new old, even though their code is not in app.R.
I've tried everything to clear everything out, but can't figure out what's going on.
I'll bet that Joe Cheng knows!

Nick

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny is seeing modules from another Project in a new Project
parts: Try restarting your R session? (In RStudio, it's Ctrl+Shift+F10) These old functions may be defined in the global environment, and restarting R may clear them out.
